result.summary: The page is largely intact; the clipped carousel items at the right edge and the partially visible bottom card are excluded per instructions. No critical or major defects are visible. Only minor observations remain around the still-loading hero image and inconsistent favorite-button styling.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in 'Popular right now' still shows a centered circular loading spinner over the food photo, indicating the image has not finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads promptly or show a neutral placeholder/skeleton instead of a persistent spinner over the content.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) affordances are inconsistent between nearby cards: the Tokumaru card uses a bare outline heart at the top-right, while the pizza card below uses a heart inside a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite control style (icon treatment and background) across cards in the same section for visual consistency.
